integrity: Proof supplied with explicit Gaussian and overlap reductions; numerical quadrature is auxiliary, exact coefficient defined as an integral.
scientific_limitations: Fixed iid Gaussian signed offsets and uniform normal directions; fixed-threshold asymptotics. The Poisson/Weibull scaling for stationary Poisson-line triangles is prior art and excluded from novelty. General parameter families, windows and independent validation not covered.
title: Gaussian-offset random-line triangles: explicit extreme-area intensity and marked concurrency geometry
